title: RogueTundra's Client Mods
description: A modpack with only client side mods, made for playing on realms or servers.
body:
This modpack contains only client side mods so as to be compatible with realms or servers.

It has a wide varienty of mods and mostly focuses on quality of life with mods like Inventory Profiles Next (which allows things like sorting chests and refilling hotbar when placing blocks), Client Tweaks (adding tweaks like not placing the last torch in offhand or autoclimbing ladders), and clientcommands (adding commands that let you quickly search chests or convert coordinates between dimensions).

Included are optimization mods like Sodium, BadOptimizations, and Dynamic FPS that will help with slower computers.

Other mods included improve the interface and give information such as AppleSkin (shows saturation and how much hunger food restores), Armor Chroma (showing what armor type you have equiped), and Simple HUD Enhanced (which shows information like coords and time).

Lastly there are mods purely for Aesthetic such as 3D Skin Layers (renders the player skin layer in 3d), Sound Physics Remastered (adds things like reverb), and Ambient Environment (adds noise to things like grass, water, and leaves for slight color differances).

There are mods which make contridictory changes to the same thing such as Status Effect Timer and Status Effect Bars, or AdvancementsSearch and AdvancementInfo Reloaded. I allowed this so the user can choose which they prefer. Before playing one of the contridictory mods should be disabled.

Full list of mods and which ones are contridictory is in a google sheets document in the wiki, Library and API mods are not included in that list. (The sheets document is currently, only representing version 1.0.0 of the pack).
